# Shaadifilms

Shaadifilms is a luxury wedding photography and cinematic videography studio based in Morjim, Goa, India. We specialize in capturing Indian weddings, including Hindu, Christian, Sikh, Muslim, and Destination weddings. Our approach focuses on timeless storytelling and premium aesthetic quality.

## Services Offered
- Premium Wedding Photography
- Cinematic Wedding Films
- Pre-wedding and Engagement Shoots
- Destination Wedding Coverage
- Live Streaming
- Luxury Wedding Albums

## Packages
We offer customizable packages for full-day, multi-day, and destination weddings. Contact us directly or visit our website to book a consultation and request a quote.
